verdict.rationale: Brevo documents unlimited multi-step automation workflows (brevo-docs-29), but nothing in the evidence shows versioning, change review, version history, or rollback for those automations. A/B testing of content variants and API access to templates are adjacent features, not automation version control. Since a marketing automation platform could plausibly offer workflow versioning, the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
